UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "if (Select-String -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}conf.d\00-amp.conf' -Pattern '^default_pass = $' -Quiet) { Write-Output 'Set the Admin Password in the AMP settings before starting RabbitMQ'; exit 1 }"
-c "if grep -qx 'default_pass = ' '{{$FullBaseDir}}conf.d/00-amp.conf'; then echo 'Set the Admin Password in the AMP settings before starting RabbitMQ'; exit 1; fi"
